title: StrumSight AI/ML release evidence report
description: Output document of tool/release/build_ai_report.py (E12-R16, ADR 0477). One document per --profile run: aggregates every capability the evidence matrix (docs/release/ai-quality-gates.md) declares, resolved against the GA-scope truth in docs/testing/device-matrix.yaml. This file documents the contract; build_ai_report.py enforces it directly rather than depending on a third-party JSON-Schema validator (no such package is guaranteed on the CI runner image, the same reasoning tool/release/generate_sbom.py's module docstring gives).

schemaVersion.description: Report contract version. build_ai_report.py always emits 1; a future incompatible change bumps this.

profile.description: Provenance only (ADR 0477 D6) — records which closed-dictionary channel produced this report. Never loosens or tightens a check.

thresholds.description: The WARN_THRESHOLD/FAIL_THRESHOLD values tool/compare_benchmarks.py's classify() classified every metric's status against (ADR 0477 D4) — echoed here, not redeclared, so a saved report documents which threshold produced it.

warn.description: tool/compare_benchmarks.py WARN_THRESHOLD at the time of this run.

fail.description: tool/compare_benchmarks.py FAIL_THRESHOLD at the time of this run.

findings.description: Every release-blocking issue this run discovered: a ga_scope:true capability with missing/unreadable evidence, an evidence modelId/modelVersion that does not match the declared model or assets/ml/model_manifest.json, or a metric classified "fail". A non-empty array means build_ai_report.py exited 1. An empty array does not by itself mean every capability was checked — see each capability's "status".

id.description: A capability id from the evidence matrix; guaranteed to also exist in docs/testing/device-matrix.yaml capabilities[].id (ADR 0477 D1) — an evidence-matrix row naming an unknown capability is a build_ai_report.py usage error, not a report entry.

status.description: "not_in_scope": docs/testing/device-matrix.yaml marks this capability ga_scope: false — its evidence is never required and never blocks (ADR 0477 D3). "missing": ga_scope: true and at least one required evidence document could not be found, parsed, or was missing a required field. "ok": ga_scope: true and every declared metric's evidence was read; individual metrics may still be "warn" or "fail" (see metrics[].status) without changing this to "missing".

error.description: Present only when status is "missing": the read/parse failure for the first evidence document that could not be used.

metrics.description: One entry per evidence-matrix row that was successfully read for this capability. Empty for "not_in_scope" and for "missing" capabilities whose evidence document could not be read at all.

capability.description: Same value as the enclosing capability's "id" — carried per-metric so a metric record is independently meaningful outside the report document (ADR 0477 D5).

metric.description: Metric name, taken verbatim from the evidence-matrix row (e.g. chord_accuracy, onset_f1_50ms).

corpusId.description: Identifies the evaluation corpus this measurement was taken on. Sourced from the evidence document; not cross-checked against a corpus registry (none exists yet) but mandatory (ADR 0477 D5).

buildSha.description: The app build the candidateValue was measured against. Sourced from the evidence document.

modelId.description: Either "none" (a purely DSP metric with no ML model in its path — only valid when the evidence-matrix row itself declares model: none, ADR 0477 D5), an assets/ml/model_manifest.json models[].filename, or a vision_models[].model_id.

modelVersion.description: "none" when modelId is "none"; otherwise must equal the manifest's training_run.identifier (models[]) or version (vision_models[]) for that modelId — build_ai_report.py exits non-zero on any other value (ADR 0477 D5) rather than emitting a mismatched report.

direction.description: Imported from tool/compare_benchmarks.py's DIRECTIONS (ADR 0477 D4) — no default, no third value.

status.description: Result of tool/compare_benchmarks.py's classify(baselineValue, candidateValue, direction) — imported, not reimplemented (ADR 0477 D4). Both the 5.0% warn and 10.0% fail boundaries are inclusive.

delta.description: The signed regression fraction classify() returned; positive means worse, regardless of direction.
